items.finding: No fresh negative runtime proof of cross-workspace rejection after bootstrap is captured by this static review.
items.evidence: Post-apply bootstrap UAT verified physical manifests and workspace list, but did not execute dedicated cross-workspace denial paths.
items.recommended_action: Prepare a dedicated negative runtime workspace-scope UAT before enabling any workspace operation.

items.finding: Governed Operations Runtime Negative UAT remains not evidenced as executed in the accepted governing handoff.
items.evidence: Governing state records it as authorized previously but not executed.
items.recommended_action: Close it as a separate controlled UAT before connecting new governed operations routes.

items.finding: Personal, commercial, and research workspaces are policy-only and have no isolated task or project registry.
items.evidence: Each policy-only workspace contains only workspace_manifest.json.
items.recommended_action: Design a workspace capability foundation with isolated registries only after scoped requirements are approved.

items.finding: A cross-workspace human-review and durable evidence-ledger workflow is not yet evidenced.
items.evidence: Local agent core exists; no accepted cross-workspace human-review lifecycle evidence is recorded.
items.recommended_action: Build Human Review and Evidence Ledger Foundation before enabling productive tool execution.
